# Google Play

9 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 4 standard (1 credit), 3 advanced (5), 1 premium (10), 1 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/google_play/app-info - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns the full canonical `App` record for one Google Play app keyed by its package name (`app_id`): title, description, developer block (incl. email/address/website), rating, price, install count + display ('1,000,000,000+'), version, size, screenshots, genres, chart tags, similar apps, and update date. The `app.store` field is always "google_play"; Apple-only leaves (advisories, languages) are null. Get the `app_id` from /v1/google_play/app-search.

**Use when** you already have an app_id and need the detail that search results leave out.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `app_id` (required) - Google Play package name (e.g. 'com.spotify.music'), from app-search. · e.g. `com.spotify.music`
- `country` (optional, string) - Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name, or a numeric code. Defaults to the US. · e.g. `United States`
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.

**Response** `App` object at `data`, `{ app }` ([full schema](schemas/App.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `app.id` | Store app ID… |
| `app.title` | App title |
| `app.store` | App marketplace ("google_play" or "app_store") |
| `app.url` |  |
| `app.developer.id` |  |
| `app.developer.name` |  |

+23 more fields in the full schema.

**Next** `google_play/app-reviews` (`app_id` ← `data.app.id`) - Get Google Play reviews for an app.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-info" \
  --data-urlencode "app_id=com.spotify.music" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google_play/app-list - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns a unified AppList for a Google Play store chart (top free, top paid, top grossing, movers & shakers, etc.), optionally scoped to a category. Each item is the same canonical `App` shape as app-search. Use it to track ranking movements or build a category leaderboard.

**Use when** you want to track ranking movements or build a category leaderboard, rather than searching for one named app.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Depth-based fan-out: page size is controlled by depth, one call.

**Query params**

- `app_collection` (required) - Chart to retrieve: topselling_free, topselling_paid, topgrossing, movers_shakers, topselling_new_free, topselling_new_paid. An unknown value is rejected with a free 400 that lists the accepted set. · e.g. `topselling_free`
- `app_category` (optional, enum: art_and_design | auto_and_vehicles | beauty | books_and_reference | business | comics | communication | dating | education | entertainment | events | finance | food_and_drink | health_and_fitness | house_and_home | libraries_and_demo | lifestyle | maps_and_navigation | medical | music_and_audio | news_and_magazines | parenting | personalization | photography | productivity | shopping | social | sports | tools | travel_and_local | video_players | android_wear | watch_face | weather | game | game_action | game_adventure | game_arcade | game_board | game_card | game_casino | game_casual | game_educational | game_music | game_puzzle | game_racing | game_role_playing | game_simulation | game_sports | game_strategy | game_trivia | game_word | family) - Optional Google Play category to scope the chart (e.g. 'photography', 'game_puzzle'). · e.g. `photography`
- `country` (optional, string) - Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name, or a numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.
- `depth` (optional, integer) - Number of apps to retrieve (default 100, rounded up to multiples of 100, max 500). The store decides how deep a chart actually goes: measured 06/09/2026, `topselling_free` returns 100 at the default and 200 at depth=500, and `topselling_new_paid` has only 5 apps in it. · e.g. `100`

**Constraints**

- `app_collection`: at most 1 comma-separated values; each value one of topselling_free | topselling_paid | topgrossing | movers_shakers | topselling_new_free | topselling_new_paid.

**Response** `AppList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ app }` ([full schema](schemas/AppList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `app.id` | Store app ID… |
| `app.title` | App title |
| `app.store` | App marketplace ("google_play" or "app_store") |
| `app.url` |  |
| `app.developer.id` |  |
| `app.developer.name` |  |

+23 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `google_play/app-info` (`app_id` ← `data.items[].app.id`) - Get full Google Play app details.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-list" \
  --data-urlencode "app_collection=topselling_free" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google_play/app-listings-search - 10 credits (premium)

Searches a real-time, filterable Google Play listings database by app title (and/or description) and returns a unified AppList. Unlike the store-chart endpoints this one is the ONE true paginator: page by passing `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` until `pagination.has_more` is false, size the page with `limit` (≤50), and read the platform-wide match count at `data.total` (14,686 for the query 'photo editor' on 06/09/2026). Each row also carries `app.ext.appdata.time_update`, the freshness stamp for that listing in the database. Premium-tier because this surface is billed per returned item.

**Use when** you must page through many results, since it is the only Google Play endpoint with real paging.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** cursor (native `offset_token`) · ≈20/page (observed once); set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/20) x 10 credits

**Query params**

- `title` (required) - App title to search for (e.g. 'photo editor'). · e.g. `photo editor`
- `description` (optional, string) - Optional app-description text to match.
- `limit` (optional, integer) - Apps per page (1-50, default 20). · e.g. `20`
- `offset` (optional, integer) - Pagination offset (up to 10,000). Prefer `cursor`: pass `pagination.next_cursor` straight back and the offset is handled for you.
- `offset_token` (optional, string) - Legacy deep-pagination token. Prefer `cursor`, which accepts `pagination.next_cursor` verbatim and works on every paginatable endpoint.
- `filters` (optional, string) - Advanced filter expression as a JSON array of clauses, e.g. [["item.rating.value",">",4]]. Must be valid JSON and must be an array: anything else is rejected with a free 400 rather than silently returning an unfiltered page. · e.g. `[["item.rating.value",">",4]]`
- `country` (optional, string) - Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name, or a numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.

**Response** `AppList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ app }` ([full schema](schemas/AppList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `app.id` | Store app ID… |
| `app.title` | App title |
| `app.store` | App marketplace ("google_play" or "app_store") |
| `app.url` |  |
| `app.developer.id` |  |
| `app.developer.name` |  |

+23 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `google_play/app-reviews` (`app_id` ← `data.items[].app.id`) - Get Google Play reviews for an app. · `google_play/app-info` (`app_id` ← `data.items[].app.id`) - Get full Google Play app details.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-listings-search" \
  --data-urlencode "title=photo editor" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google_play/app-reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns a unified ReviewList of Google Play user reviews for an app, keyed by its package name (`app_id` on every review's `entity_id`). Each review carries the star rating, full text, reviewer name + avatar, helpful-vote count, developer `responses[]` (reply text + date), and publish date: on the SAME canonical `Review` shape used by Amazon, Google Shopping, and Trustpilot. Google reviews have no title (always null). `depth` returns reviews in batches of 150 (max 600).

**Use when** you want to read what users say about one app; reviews come back in batches of 150, up to 600 in total. **Not for** both stores at once with themes and sentiment over time (prism/app-reviews).
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.
**Paging** single page - Depth-based fan-out: page size is controlled by depth, one call.

**Query params**

- `app_id` (required) - Google Play package name (e.g. 'com.spotify.music'), from app-search. · e.g. `com.spotify.music`
- `country` (optional, string) - Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name, or a numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.
- `depth` (optional, integer) - Number of reviews to retrieve (default 150, batches of 150, max 600). · e.g. `150`
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: newest | most_relevant) - Review ordering: `newest` (default) or `most_relevant`. · e.g. `newest`
- `rating` (optional, integer) - Filter to a single star rating (1-5). Verified working on this store (measured 06/09/2026: `rating=5` returns 150 five-star reviews, `rating=1` returns 150 one-star). The Apple App Store has no equivalent filter upstream.
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality)

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `review.entity_id` | ID of the reviewed entity… |
| `review.helpful_votes` | Helpful-vote count (Amazon; null elsewhere) |

+10 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "app_id=com.spotify.music" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google_play/app-search - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns a unified AppList of Google Play apps matching a keyword: title, icon, developer, rating, price/is_free, and store URL on every item, on the same canonical `App` shape used across every app marketplace (`app.store` = "google_play"). Detail-only fields (description, screenshots, installs) are null on search items; fetch /v1/google_play/app-info for the full record. Served from the Google Play catalogue: a first, uncached call is task-polled upstream and typically takes 3 to 15s, with a review pull at high `depth` reaching 40s. Set a client timeout of at least 60s.

**Use when** you want to find an app's package name by keyword; description, screenshots, and install counts come from app-info.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Depth-based fan-out: page size is controlled by depth, one call.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keyword (e.g. 'photo editor'). · e.g. `photo editor`
- `country` (optional, string) - Storefront country as an ISO code ('US'), a full name ('United States'), or a numeric location code ('2840'). Defaults to the US. · e.g. `United States`
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.
- `depth` (optional, integer) - Number of results to retrieve (default 30, rounded up to multiples of 30, max 300). Note: Google Play's organic keyword search typically exposes only ~30 ranked results, so higher depth values rarely return more. To page deeper for app discovery, use /v1/google_play/app-listings-search (a filterable title/description database with real limit/offset/total). · e.g. `30`

**Response** `AppList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ app }` ([full schema](schemas/AppList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `app.id` | Store app ID… |
| `app.title` | App title |
| `app.store` | App marketplace ("google_play" or "app_store") |
| `app.url` |  |
| `app.developer.id` |  |
| `app.developer.name` |  |

+23 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `google_play/app-info` (`app_id` ← `data.items[].app.id`) - Full details for each app. · `google_play/app-reviews` (`app_id` ← `data.items[].app.id`) - User reviews of each app.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=photo editor" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google_play/categories - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the list of Google Play app categories used by the `app_category` filter on /v1/google_play/app-list. Static reference data: heavily cached.

**Use when** you want to look up a valid category value before calling app-list.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Response** `Analytics`. Fields not published yet - call it once; `/v1/utility/endpoint?id=google_play/categories` serves the current contract.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google_play/languages - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the languages (name + code) supported by the Google Play App Data endpoints. Use a code as the `language` param. Static reference data: heavily cached.

**Use when** you want to find a valid value for the language parameter on the other Google Play endpoints.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Response** `Analytics` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ language_code, language_name }` (inferred from a sample): `language_code`, `language_name`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/languages" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google_play/locations - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the Google Play storefronts (name + numeric location code + ISO country code) accepted by the `country` param on every google_play endpoint: 211 countries. Static reference data, heavily cached. Storefronts are country-level, so a sub-country code resolves to its parent and returns that country's data: `country=1019999` (a Minnesota city) and `country=US` returned byte-identical charts on 06/09/2026. `location_type=all` returns the full underlying geo tree instead, all 269,681 rows of it (cities, postal codes, neighbourhoods, airports), which is a 46 MB response and rarely what you want here.

**Use when** you want to find a valid value for the country parameter on the other Google Play endpoints.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `location_type` (optional, enum: country | all) - `country` (default) returns the storefronts the `country` param accepts. `all` returns the full underlying geo tree, including cities, postal codes and neighbourhoods, which all resolve to their parent country. · e.g. `country`

**Response** `Analytics` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): `country_iso_code`, `location_code`, `location_name`, `location_name_parent`, `location_type`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/locations" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/google_play/search-suggestions - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Google Play's search autocomplete suggestions for a keyword stem: the same terms the store's search box surfaces. The day Play starts autocompleting a phrase, real demand exists; poll a stem daily and diff to catch rising app keywords early. Each item is `{ term, priority }` ranked by Play's own order (Play exposes no numeric score). Returns a list under `items`.

**Use when** you want it for store keyword research: poll a stem daily and diff the list to catch rising app searches early.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Play's autocomplete returns one fixed block of suggestions and exposes no cursor, offset or size parameter.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Partial search keyword to autocomplete (e.g. 'reverse'). · e.g. `reverse`
- `country` (optional, string) - ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 storefront country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'kr'). Defaults to 'us'. Anything that is not alpha-2 is rejected with a free 400; an unrecognised alpha-2 code is forwarded, and Google Play answers it with its default storefront rather than an error, so check the code if results look wrong for the market. · e.g. `us`
- `language` (optional, string) - ISO 639-1 language code. Defaults to 'en'. · e.g. `en`

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ priority, term }` (inferred from a sample): `priority`, `term`.

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/search-suggestions" \
  --data-urlencode "query=reverse" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
